# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "D095 fiber_retired"
description: "Task.join was called on a fiber that Task.cancel had already used up (join on a cancelled fiber): a cancelled fiber has no result."
---

A runtime defect: the running program stops with it; no compile phase reports it, and `try` cannot catch it. `sakura explain D095` prints this explanation offline.

`Task.join` was called on a fiber that `Task.cancel` had already used up (`join on a cancelled
fiber`): a cancelled fiber has no result. Cancel or join a fiber, never both. On the WASM runtime
the code also reports a join of a retired fiber, which a program that passes the escape check
cannot reach; that is a runtime or compiler bug, please report it (`runtime/rt/ABI.md` §13).

Runtime defects come from running programs, so `compiler/tests/ui` has no fixture for them; the explanation above names the repair.
